description: This PHP file contains class definitions and functions related to the installation process of SuiteCRM, including layout rendering, localization, and configuration setup. It also includes license and copyright information.

classes.name: NonDBLocalization
classes.description: A class extending Localization to handle non-database localization options, such as locale name formats.

classes.name: InstallLayout
classes.description: A class providing static methods to generate HTML layout components for the installation pages.

classes.name: DisplayErrors
classes.description: A class to manage error reporting settings, allowing to show and restore error display configurations.

methods.name: getSelect
methods.description: Generates an HTML select element with options and a default selection.

methods.name: getHeaderStyles
methods.description: Returns HTML link tags for header stylesheets.

methods.name: getHeaderScripts
methods.description: Returns HTML script tags for header JavaScript files.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Creates the HTML head section for the installation page.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Generates the HTML form layout for installation steps.

methods.name: getOutput
methods.description: Assembles the complete HTML page for the installation step.

methods.name: getFormItems
methods.description: Builds the form items for database configuration, site settings, localization, branding, and other setup options.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Renders the complete installation form page with all components.
